intentEvidence: These two commands were the main motivation for me to create this plugin as they feel natural to how I take notes for myself.
motivation: The author wanted a way to quickly paste a URL in a daily note, have it automatically be prettified, and then be able to embed that reference in my later daily notes.
problem: Users need a quick and natural way to insert complex, formatted content, such as GitHub pull request references, directly into notes without manual formatting.
summary: Inline Commands allows users to execute commands and insert content directly into notes by typing % to trigger a suggestion dropdown.
